name: @mcp-abap-adt/compact-ro

tools.name: HandlerGet
tools.description: [read-only] Reads one part of the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …). part selects it: source (default) the source alone, in one request; metadata the ADT metadata document alone, in one request; urls (SERVICE_BINDING) the service URL, its $metadata and the browser preview, contents (PACKAGE) the objects the package holds, its walk read level by level in ADT batch envelopes; package_names lists several packages, read together, one entry per package in the order given. A source document answers { part: 'source', source } and a metadata document { part: 'metadata', metadata }, beside the object's name. Parts per type: PACKAGE metadata, contents; DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, FUNCTION_GROUP metadata; LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, TRANSPORT, UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST source; SERVICE_BINDING source, metadata, urls; every other type source, metadata. A part outside the type's list is answered with that list. Three parts read the repository by ADT address: object_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*), node_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*, node_id, with_short_descriptions; one node level; a package's blank answer is the empty listing with blank stating its two readings: an empty package, or an unknown package name) and virtual_folders(object_search_pattern, preselection, facet_order, with_versions, ignore_short_descriptions). Two parts read an activation run by its id, in one request each: activation_status(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, status, document }, the run's status (finished, error, failed, or its progress while it runs) and its status document as SAP answered it; activation_results(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, messages, document }, the messages the run produced and its results document as SAP answered it. Otherwise object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*; part contents: package_name* or package_names*), DOMAIN(domain_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*), TABLE(table_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*), DDL(ddl_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*), CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(interface_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or function_module_name* with function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*), UNIT_TEST(run_id*), CDS_UNIT_TEST(run_id*), TRANSPORT(transport_number*). TRANSPORT answers the objects a task holds, each with its position in the task's object list; for a request, every task's entries, each once, with its task number and position. UNIT_TEST and CDS_UNIT_TEST read the run's result in one request and answer { success, run_id, run_result }, run_result the result document SAP answered, parsed. Valid once the status is FINISHED; a finished run's result carries executionTime. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. When part is source (absent reads as source) and object_type is one of TRANSPORT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION; or part is metadata and object_type is one of PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION; or part is object_structure; or part is node_structure and object_adt_type is given; or part is virtual_folders; or part is activation_status and run_id is given; or part is activation_results and run_id is given; or part is source (absent reads as source) and object_type is one of UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST and run_id is given, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP. Applies to the repository reads: object_type PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION, TRANSPORT, and the parts object_structure, node_structure, virtual_folders.

object_type.description: ABAP object type for routed compact operation.

part.description: The part to read: source (the source alone), metadata (the ADT metadata document alone), urls (the service and preview URLs), contents (the objects a package holds); each object type answers the parts it has, and a part outside them is answered with the list of its parts. Three parts read the repository by ADT address: object_structure (object_adt_type*, object_name*), node_structure (object_adt_type*, object_name*, node_id, with_short_descriptions) and virtual_folders (object_search_pattern, preselection, facet_order, with_versions, ignore_short_descriptions). Two parts read an activation run by run_id*: activation_status (its status) and activation_results (the messages it produced).

package_names.description: Several package names (part contents), read together: one entry per package, in the order given, each { package_name, contents } or { package_name, error }.

max_results.description: Maximum number of members listed per package (part contents).

include_descriptions.description: Include each member's description (part contents). Where the system serves ADT batch, each description is read from the member's metadata: one more read per member, which on a large package takes most of the call.

function_module_name.description: Function module name: GROUP|MODULE, its function group first, or the module alone with function_group_name.

function_group_name.description: Function group name (FUNCTION_GROUP; FUNCTION_MODULE given as the module's name).

transport_number.description: Transport request or task number (TRANSPORT). A request lists the entries of all its tasks; a task lists its own.

run_id.description: Run id: a unit test run (UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST) or an activation run (parts activation_status, activation_results).

object_adt_type.description: ADT type code of the object (object_structure) or of the parent node (node_structure).

node_id.description: Node id to expand (node_structure); the root when absent.

tools.name: HandlerSearch
tools.description: [read-only] Searches the ABAP repository for the objects whose name matches query, a name or a mask. Required: query*. Optional: object_type, max_results (default 100). Response: one object per line. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

query.description: Object name or mask, with * as a wildcard.

object_type.description: ADT object type to restrict the search to.

tools.name: HandlerWhereUsed
tools.description: [read-only] Lists where the object named by object_type and object_name is used — a class, interface, program, include, function group, function module (BAPI included), package, table, structure, domain, data element or CDS DDL source: the objects that use, call or reference it, with type and package. Required: object_type*, object_name*. Optional: function_group_name (FUNCTION_MODULE), max_results (default 100). Response: JSON. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

object_type.description: Type of the object whose usages are listed.

function_group_name.description: Function group of the function module (FUNCTION_MODULE).

max_results.description: Maximum number of referencing objects returned.

tools.name: HandlerGetData
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the rows of the table or CDS view named by object_name, or the rows sql_query selects: every column of object_name, or what sql_query selects with its columns, conditions and order. Required: object_name or sql_query. Optional: max_rows (default 100). Response: JSON. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

object_name.description: Table or CDS view whose rows are read, all columns. Used when sql_query is absent.

sql_query.description: ABAP SQL SELECT naming the columns, conditions and order to read.

tools.name: HandlerValidate
tools.description: [read-only] Validates a new object named by object_type and object_name before it is created. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*, superclass), PROGRAM(object_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*, super_package), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(object_name*=service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*). Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_type.description: Object type to validate before create. Supported: CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, PACKAGE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION, SERVICE_BINDING.

object_name.description: Required object name. For SERVICE_BINDING this is the service binding name; a function module is named GROUP|MODULE.

package_name.description: Optional package context for validation (especially for create scenarios).

super_package.description: Super package of the package to validate (PACKAGE).

superclass.description: Superclass of the class to validate (CLASS).

description.description: Optional object description used during validation.

behavior_definition.description: Optional behavior definition name, used when validating behavior implementation.

root_entity.description: Optional CDS root entity name, used for behavior-related validation.

implementation_type.description: Optional implementation type, used for behavior implementation validation.

service_definition_name.description: Required when object_type=SERVICE_BINDING. Service definition paired with the binding.

service_binding_version.description: Optional service binding version for SERVICE_BINDING.

tools.name: HandlerCheckRun
tools.description: [read-only] Runs a syntax check on the object named by object_type and object_name. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*). source_code checks unsaved source given in the call, for CLASS, STRUCTURE and DDL. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_type.description: Object type. Supported: CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, PACKAGE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, METADATA_EXTENSION.

object_name.description: Object name. A function module is named GROUP|MODULE, its function group first.

source_code.description: Source to check instead of the saved one; nothing is saved. CLASS, STRUCTURE and DDL only.

tools.name: HandlerDeletionCheck
tools.description: [read-only] Asks SAP whether the object named by object_type and object_name can be deleted: sends the deletion check request for its type, and answers SAP's verdict as it came: deletable true with the object and SAP's message when it carries one, or SAP's refusal with its words. object_type and object_name required: PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST (its test class), PROGRAM [onprem only], INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE (object_name GROUP|MODULE), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_type.description: Object type. Supported: PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION.

object_name.description: Object name. A function module is named GROUP|MODULE, its function group first.

tools.name: HandlerUnitTestStatus
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the status of the ABAP Unit test run named by run_id. Required: run_id*. Optional: with_long_polling. Response: JSON. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

with_long_polling.description: Use long polling while waiting for completion.

tools.name: HandlerUnitTestResult
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the result of the ABAP Unit test run named by run_id*, in one request (GET /sap/bc/adt/abapunit/results/{run_id}), and answers { success, run_id, run_result }: run_result is the result document SAP answered, parsed. Valid once the status is FINISHED; a finished run's result carries executionTime. Optional: with_navigation_uris, format (abapunit or junit). When run_id is given, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

with_navigation_uris.description: Include ADT navigation URIs in the result payload.

tools.name: HandlerCdsUnitTestStatus
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the status of the CDS unit test run named by run_id. Required: run_id*. Optional: with_long_polling. Response: JSON. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

with_long_polling.description: Use long polling while waiting for completion.

tools.name: HandlerCdsUnitTestResult
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the result of the CDS unit test run named by run_id*, in one request (GET /sap/bc/adt/abapunit/results/{run_id}), and answers { success, run_id, run_result }: run_result is the result document SAP answered, parsed. Valid once the status is FINISHED; a finished run's result carries executionTime. Optional: with_navigation_uris, format (abapunit or junit). When run_id is given, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

with_navigation_uris.description: Include ADT navigation URIs in the result payload.

tools.name: HandlerProfileList
tools.description: [read-only] Lists the ABAP profiler trace files. Response: JSON. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

tools.name: HandlerProfileView
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP profiler trace named by trace_id_or_uri in the view given (hit list, statements or database accesses), raw or analysed. Required: trace_id_or_uri*, view*(hitlist|statements|db_accesses). Optional: mode(raw|analyze, default raw), top(analyze only), with_system_events, id, with_details, auto_drill_down_threshold. Response: JSON. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

mode.description: "raw" returns the parsed trace payload as-is (default). "analyze" returns a compact summary instead — totals plus the top-ranked entries — via the same trace view.

top.description: Number of top-ranked rows to include when mode is "analyze". Default 10. Ignored for mode "raw".

tools.name: HandlerDumpList
tools.description: [read-only] Reads one page of the runtime feed named by feed_type in one request, newest first: the ABAP short dumps (runtime errors) of the user, object_name or time range from–to given, or system messages or SAP Gateway errors. Optional: feed_type(dumps|system_messages|gateway_errors, default dumps), user, runtime_error, exception, object_name, package, component, top (1 to 100), from, to. Response: JSON { feed_type, count, entries, next_to }; each dump carries dump_id; next_to is the `to` of SAP's next link, present when more remain. The next link's page starts at the boundary second, inclusive: entries of that second may repeat; match them by dump_id. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

feed_type.description: Which runtime feed to list. Default "dumps" (ABAP short dumps). "system_messages" and "gateway_errors" read the other two ADT runtime feeds through the same call.

runtime_error.description: Dumps whose runtime error contains this text, in any case.

exception.description: Dumps whose exception class contains this text, in any case.

object_name.description: Dumps whose terminated object name contains this text, in any case.

package.description: Dumps whose object package contains this text, in any case.

component.description: Dumps whose application component contains this text, in any case.

top.description: Entries the page holds, 1 to 100 (SAP answers 100 when top is absent).

to.description: End of time range (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS), inclusive: the page holds the entries up to that second; a previous answer's next_to is the next page's to, and that page starts at the boundary second, inclusive.

tools.name: HandlerDumpView
tools.description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP short dump (runtime error) named by dump_id in the view given. Required: dump_id* (id or URI). Optional: view(default|summary|formatted). Response: JSON. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

dump_id.description: The dump's dump_id, or its URI.

view.description: "summary" — runtime error, exception, terminated program, time, user and termination position; "default" — that summary and the parsed dump; "formatted" — the dump as formatted text.

tools.name: HandlerServiceBindingListTypes
tools.description: [read-only] Lists the available service binding types. Optional: response_format(xml|json|plain). Response: XML/JSON/plain by response_format. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

response_format.description: Response format for protocol types list.

tools.name: HandlerServiceBindingValidate
tools.description: [read-only] Validates a new service binding named by service_binding_name for the service definition named by service_definition_name, before it is created. Required: service_binding_name*, service_definition_name*. Optional: service_binding_version, package_name, description. Response: JSON. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

service_definition_name.description: Service definition name to pair with binding.

tools.name: HandlerLeftoverSessionList
tools.description: [read-only] Lists the SAP sessions of this server's destination an ended server process left open (it was killed before logging them off): handle, role (built or debugger), destination, user, when recorded. Read from the session records alone. Only sessions of ended processes are listed. A server starting while exactly one built session of its destination is left is born on it; with several, all stay listed and untaken. Runs outside batch mode.

tools.name: HandlerLeftoverSessionLogoff
tools.description: [read-only] Logs off a leftover SAP session (any role), releasing every lock it holds; only the logoff is sent, credential-free. Its record is deleted afterwards. Runs outside batch mode.

handle.description: The handle of a leftover session, as the list answers it.

tools.name: HandlerBatch
tools.description: [read-only] action 'begin': Starts batch mode on this server. In batch mode each call of a tool marked recordable is recorded under the next number, starting at 1, and answers with empty content. Answers the state_handle, which HTTP clients send in the x-mcp-state-handle header with every call of the batch. action 'end': Sends the recorded calls in one envelope with the credentials in force and ends batch mode. Splits SAP's answer into each call's parts and answers the number of recorded calls, of requests sent and of parts received; when sending fails, the parts received differ from the requests sent or the answer fails to split, answers that error, and every number of the batch then answers it. action 'answers' (with number or numbers): Answers the calls of the last executed batch by number: for each number asked, the tool's answer, built from the call's parts of SAP's response when the number is first read and kept for later reads; the numbers asked are processed in parallel. Takes one number or a list of numbers; an unknown number answers as unknown.

action.description: begin: switch into batch mode; end: send the recorded calls and leave batch mode; answers: read the last batch's answers by number (with number or numbers).

number.description: answers only: one batch number to read (an integer of at least 1); give this or numbers, not both.

numbers.description: answers only: several batch numbers to read, answered in the order given; give this or number, not both.
